reviewFocus: Service language is industry-agnostic: snow, lawn and landscaping share screens, so no hardcoded 'plow' or 'snow' copy on a generic action.
Route state must survive the app being killed and must not end because a view disappeared.
The widget reads only app-group UserDefaults written by WidgetDataStore; it never touches SwiftData.
Any new persistent store is also removed by Delete Account & Data (App Review 5.1.1(v)).
Money is never computed in more than one place, and invoice numbers must not collide across devices.
